hebrewText: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ

tokens.bdb: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.enLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanation: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanationEn: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile

tokens.bdb: to rub or strike the hands together (in exultation)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to rub or strike the hands together
tokens.enLiteralWord: to rub or strike the hands together
tokens.explanation: to rub or strike the hands together
tokens.explanationEn: to rub or strike the hands together

tokens.bdb: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
tokens.kjv: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal
tokens.enLiteralWord: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal
tokens.explanation: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal
tokens.explanationEn: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal

tokens.kjv: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
tokens.kjv: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.
